title: Kicked Spicy Jamaican Rhubarb Skillet
description: A mustardy and chewy Jamaican dish featuring rhubarb, perfect for a brunch mood, made using a bain-marie for low-sodium friendliness
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit
In a bowl, whisk together the jerk seasoning, flour, and a pinch of salt
In a skillet, heat a couple of tablespoons of oil over medium heat
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent
Add the chopped scotch bonnet peppers and cook for another minute
Add the rhubarb and cook until it starts to soften
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs and low-sodium chicken broth
Pour the egg mixture over the rhubarb mixture in the skillet
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake for 20 minutes
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
